items.requirement: Independent third-party audit is complete and every Critical/High finding is fixed and re-verified
Open residual risks in the threat model are fixed or explicitly accepted
Protocol invariants are documented and their property test passes on the release commit
Dependencies pass the supply-chain policy with no unreviewed or expired exceptions
Release WASM hash is recorded and the upgrade procedure is reviewed
Contract suite (flat and skewed fixtures), coverage and size gates are green on the release commit
Testnet smoke test and upgrade simulation pass on the release commit
Manual end-to-end run (create, approve, execute) against the deployed testnet contract is recorded
Owner keys are on hardware wallets and the key-management guide is followed
Guardian is set and a freeze/unfreeze drill has been run
Key rotation and upgrade rollback runbooks are rehearsed
Monitoring and alerting for the deployed contract and indexer are live
Mainnet deployment steps are dry-run and the contract ID is recorded
